profile.summary: PeerForward, formerly College Summit, is a nonprofit that trains students in low-income communities to be peer leaders who help classmates apply to and enroll in college. It also places paid peer advisors in colleges to help students stay enrolled through graduation. It began in 1996 in Washington, DC.
